description: This key's spend and the account's remaining balance, in cents. Free; check it before a long run. A key in a subscription's workspace is paid by its plan instead, and gets `subscription`: `week.used_percent` is how much of this week is used (100 = used up) and `week.resets_at` when it starts again. When the balance runs out, or the week does with no API credit to carry on, calls are refused with 402: tell the user instead of retrying.

days.description: Days of workspace and store spend, 1-365 (default 7); the key's total is lifetime.

name: usage
title: What this key has spent
